mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exercises (workout_id, name, weight, sets, reps, calories, calorie_duration_seconds) VALUES (#{workoutDbId}, #{name}, #{weight}, #{sets}, #{reps}, #{calories}, #{calorieDurationSeconds})
mapper.update: UPDATE exercises SET workout_id = #{workoutDbId}, name = #{name}, weight = #{weight}, sets = #{sets}, reps = #{reps}, calories = #{calories}, calorie_duration_seconds = #{calorieDurationSeconds} WHERE id = #{id}
